source_title: What Should I Do If I Can T Complete The Payment
snippet_primary: "In some countries, there are local/national taxes that are applied to international purchases or to currencies that are different from that of your local currency which can result in an additional charge."
subject_exact: Domestika help center (article 360003447297, undated) states some countries apply local or national taxes to international purchases or foreign currency transactions, resulting in additional charges to the buyer
local_qualifiers: Local/national taxes may apply to international purchases or foreign currency transactions in some countries
parser_notes: support.domestika.org article 360003447297 (undated). Country-level taxes on international purchases or cross-currency transactions can generate additional buyer charges.
